name: Keith A Kudrna

bio.statement: The Oregon Blue Book lists Keith Kudrna as mayor of Fairview.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State (Oregon Blue Book)

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Kudrna lists his occupation as residential home designer.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

verification.note: Statement said his present occupation was 'with Suntel House Plans'; the pamphlet lists Suntel House Plans, Inc under previous employment, not present occupation, and the excerpt does not mention it. Removed the employer from the statement.

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists the Fairview Planning Commission (2006-2016), City Council (2016-2023) and mayor (2023-2026).
bio.excerpt: Fairview Planning Commission 2006-2016, Fairview City Council 2016-2023, Mayor of Fairview 2023-2026

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists the Phoenix Institute of Technology as his education.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

positions.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Kudrna cites adding sidewalks along 223rd between Halsey and Bridge Street under public safety.
positions.excerpt: adding much needed sidewalks along 223 between Halsey and Bridge Street.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

positions.statement: His pamphlet statement says Fairview passed a balanced budget with no deficit spending in 2026.
positions.excerpt: In 2026 we passed a balanced budget with no deficit spending.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

positions.statement: His pamphlet statement says growth should be done intentionally with future impact in mind.
positions.excerpt: it’s more important than ever to make sure that the growth is done intentionally with future impact in mind.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

positions.statement: His pamphlet statement says funding city projects will require relationships he has built with regional leaders.
positions.excerpt: Providing funding for these projects will require relationships that I have built with regional leaders.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

positions.statement: In an October 2026 KATU report on Multnomah County ambulance response times, Kudrna calls differing response times for Fairview and Wood Village an inequity.
positions.excerpt: "This is the inequity that we're looking at,"

verification.note: Re-fetched; quote present, KATU byline Tanvi Varma, dated 2026-10-01. Article context: residents on the Wood Village/Fairview side of Glisan may wait longer for an ambulance than Gresham residents across the street.

gaps: No voting record collected (council votes not in scope of fixed search set)
No campaign website listed in pamphlet statement (email only)

verification_summary.balance_notes: Unopposed race (fairview-mayor). Kudrna's statement plus Blue Book and one dated KATU quote; no balance comparison applicable. Spot-search found no missed T1/T2/T3 material. Incumbency (mayor) confirmed by Oregon Blue Book and his own statement ('Mayor of Fairview 2023-2026').
